name: agrobloom-ai
description: AgroBloom AI - Advanced Crop and Flower Plant Disease Detection System

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,AI-SERVICE,CLIENT" -c "blue,magenta,green" "npm --prefix server run dev" "python ai-service/main.py" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.test: npm run test:client && npm run test:server && npm run test:ai
